answer: Each epoch the payout pools in a karst aquifer fed only by stranger-verified jobs, and every claim draws from it through a ripple: the first draw costs one bond, but each draw sends a ripple through the aquifer that raises the price of the next draw from the same funding trail, so the k-th clone pays k times the first while sharing one pool. When draws sink the aquifer to its nadir it drains, laying every draw receipt bare side by side; receipts copied across clones void the whole trail and burn all its bonds. One honest agent draws once at the base price.
